rows.anchor: after being inebriated with it, a person starts insulting and blaming his adversaries and their daughters and daughters-in-law.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise’s wine instead spreads love and affection.
rows.anchor: the wine of Paradise will spread the fragrance of love and affection.

rows.speaker: author

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reunited in Paradise, its people eagerly ask one another how they endured the journey and found their families together.
rows.anchor: the dwellers of Paradise will anxiously turn to each another and inquire what happened.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In earthly life, they worried about their families’ fate as much as their own.
rows.anchor: they remained anxious for their family and were concerned about their fate in the same manner they were concerned about their own fate.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They did not take tribal standing as a birthright entitling them to worldly blessings that nobody could remove.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They kept the Hereafter in view and prayed to be raised as leaders of the righteous, not the defiant.

rows.speaker: author

rows.anchor: they always impressed upon their children to adhere to the prayer, pay zakāh and remain fearful of God

rows.speaker: author

rows.anchor: as a reward for remaining fearful and anxious, the Almighty looked upon them with favour and united their children with them in Paradise

rows.claim: The term samūm means a hot wind or a flame of fire.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As an adjective for God, barr means that He fulfills all promises to His creatures; truthfulness and loyalty define the word.
rows.anchor: When this word is used as an adjective for the Almighty, it means that He will fulfil all the promises He made to His creatures.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Raḥīm adds that God forgives people’s mistakes and grants further favors as well as fulfilling promises.
